# Entry

The entries of the systemd journal. `osapi behavior get --name entry` and
`osapi behavior method get` show the same.

## Method list

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | list                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Verb        | read                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Description | List the entries of the journal                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Detail      | Runs journalctl --output=json, the newest entries last: the last 100 unless lines says, of one unit when unit says, since a time when since says, and at a priority or above when priority says. A priority is its name, such as err or info. The hand-written log domain read the Debian family only; this reads each Linux host that has journald. |
| HTTP        | GET                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/log/entry                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Permission  | log:read                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Command     | [osapi client node log entry list](../../../usage/cli/client/node/log/entry/list.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Input type  | ListInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Output type | \[]Entry                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

### Input (4)

| FIELD    | TYPE    | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                                           | DESCRIPTION                                                                                     |
| -------- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| unit     | string  | no       | pattern ^\[a-zA-Z0-9:_.@-]+$                          | Only the entries of this systemd unit, such as nginx.service                                    |
| lines    | integer | no       | min 1, max 10000                                      | How many of the newest entries; 100 when it is not set                                          |
| since    | string  | no       |                                                       | Only the entries since this time, in any form that journalctl --since takes, such as 1 hour ago |
| priority | string  | no       | one of emerg alert crit err warning notice info debug | Only the entries at this priority or above                                                      |

### Output (5)

| FIELD     | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION                            |
| --------- | ------- | -------------------------------------- |
| timestamp | string  | When journald recorded it, in RFC 3339 |
| unit      | string  | The syslog identifier that wrote it    |
| priority  | string  | Its priority, by name                  |
| message   | string  | The message                            |
| pid       | integer | The process that wrote it              |

### Examples (2)

| EXAMPLE                                     | INPUT                                                        | OUTPUT                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| The newest entries                          | (none)                                                       | \[message=Started nginx, pid=1234, priority=info, timestamp=2024-03-31T23:50:45.123456Z, unit=nginx] \[message=Accepted key, pid=5678, priority=notice, timestamp=2024-03-31T23:50:46Z, unit=sshd] |
| The last entry of one unit at info or above | unit=nginx.service, lines=1, since=1 hour ago, priority=info | \[message=Started nginx, pid=1234, priority=info, timestamp=2024-03-31T23:50:45.123456Z, unit=nginx]                                                                                               |
